newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice hits fresh contract highs on export data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice hits fresh contract highs on export data.

text.p: CBOT rice futures hit fresh contract highs on Friday with most contracts in fast dealings on surprisingly strong USDA weekly export sales, traders said.
USDA on Friday pegged weekly net rice export sales at 120,900 tonnes, above expectations for 60,000 to 65,000 tonnes, traders said.
"Export sales and ongoing demand for paddy rice boosted the market," one rice trader said.
Strong technical resistance was pegged at the $12 per cwt level in the March contract, technical traders said.
At 1015 CST, rice was up six to 16 cents per cwt with March up 16 at $11.88.
